ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAND EASEMENTAGREEMENT This Zoning Lot Development Agreement (this “Agreement'") made as of December 21, 2006 by and between WASHINGTON MUTUAL BANK,a federal association having an office at 1301 Second Avenue,WMC1007,Seattle,WA 98101 (*WAMU")andAMERICAN RE.ALTY SUNNYSIDE LLC,a New York limited liability company having an office at 50-18 Skillman Avenue.Woodside, NY 11377 ("ARS"). WIINESSEIH WHEREAS, WAMU is the owner of fee title to the parcel of land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the County of Queens, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address of 46-10 Queens Boulevard a/k/a 46-15 Greenpoint Avenue and the lot designation of Tax Lot 5, Block 152, on the Tax Map of the City of New York, which land is more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “WAMU Land", said building and improvements. together with any additions, alterations to and future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the "WAMU Building", and the WAMU Land and the WAMU Building being hereinafter referred to collectively as the "WAMU Property"); WHEREAS, ARS is the owner of fee title to the parcel of land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the County of Queens, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address of 46-02 Queens Boulevard a/k/a 46-05 Greenpoint Avenue and the lot designation of Tax Lot 7, Block 152. on the Tax Map of the City of New York, which land is together with any additions, alterations to and future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “ARS Building", and the ARS Land and the ARS Building being hereinafter referred to collectively as the"ARS Property"): WHEREAS. pursuant to a Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement made by WAMU dated October12.2006 and recorded on October16,2006 in the records of theNew York City Register under City Register File No. 200600058296, the WAMU Property and the theZoningResolution of the City ofNewYork,effective as of December 15,1961.asamended (such single zoning lot is hereinafter referred to as the “Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS. the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Zoning Lot; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained and other good and valuable consideration, the mutual receipt and legal sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: gicr.152 （oT 7 -9 Bi(:iSl  5 1GD A 1

Certain Definitions: The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions as hereinafter set forth: (a) The term “DOB" shall mean the New York City Department of Buildings orsuchentity asshallsucceed to thejurisdiction thereof. (b)The term "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to the Zoning Lot, to develop the ZoningLot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by multiplying the area of the Zoning Lot by the maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district or districts in which the Zoning Lot is located. (c) The term "Zoning Lot" shall have the meaning given such term in the third recital hereof. (d)"Excess Development Rights" shall mean that portion of all of the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the land which exceeds the Floor Area Development Rights utilized by the building on the date thereof. "zoning lot" shall be defined and construed as those terms are defined and construed in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. (f) The term “Zoning Resolution” shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the CityofNewYork.effective asofDecember15,1961,asamended. 2. Construction Work:Removal of Existing Violations:TemporaryEasements. Within fifteen (15) days after the date hereof, ARS shall submit toWAMU detailed architectural plans and specifications and permit applications for the following construction work to be performed: (a) all work required to achieve a fire division between the WAMU Building and the ARS Building (the“Fire Division Work"); (b) all work required to separate the water service (fire/domestic) for the WAMU building and the ARS Building including (i) the installation of a new water meter to exclusively service the ARS Property, and (ii) the installation ofa new valve assembly and backflow preventor for a dedicated sprinkler line to the ARS Property (the *Plumbing Work"): and (c)all work required to separate the electrical service to the ARS Property and the WAMU Property (the “Electrical Work"). Within fifteen (15) days after submission of the foregoing plans and permit applications, WAMU shall either grant its written approval thereof or submit a written statement of its comments or objections thereto.
